```{r}
#| warning: false

# Load libraries 
library(here)

library(spData)
library(kableExtra)
```

# Load the data
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Exclusive Economic Zones (EEZs) in the West Coast, vector data
eez <- st_read(here( "data", "wc_regions_clean.shp")) 

# Depth of the ocean, raster data
depth <- rast(here("data", "depth.tif"))

# All the sea surface temperature (SST) rasters from 2008-2012
sst_files <- list.files(path = "data/sst",
                        pattern = "\\.tif$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
# Create a raster stack that contains data for all five years                       
sst <- rast(sst_files)

# Make the depth raster have the same CRS as sst raster stack
crs(depth) <- crs(sst) 
```


```{r}
# Verify that all CRSs match
if((st_crs(eez) == st_crs(sst)) & (st_crs(eez) == st_crs(depth) & (st_crs(sst) == st_crs(depth)))){
  print("coordinate reference systems match!")
}else{
  warning("coordinate reference systems do NOT match")
  print(paste("eez has ", st_crs(eez)$epsg, "EPSG"))
  print(paste("depth has",  st_crs(depth)$epsg, "EPSG"))
  print(paste("sst has",  st_crs(sst)$epsg, "EPSG"))
}
```

# Process data
```{r}
#  Mean SST from 2008-2012 in Celsius
sst_C <- mean(sst, na.rm = TRUE) - 273.15
# Crop depth raster to match the extent of the SST raster
depth_cropped <- crop(depth, sst_C)

# Resample the depth data to match the resolution of the SST data using the bilinear method approach
depth_resampled <- resample(depth_cropped, sst_C, method = "bilinear")

# Check if features match
cat("After resampling:\n")
cat("CRS match:    ", same.crs(sst_C, depth_resampled), "\n")
cat("Resolutions match:", all(res(sst_C) == res(depth_resampled)), "\n")
cat("Origins match:    ", all(round(origin(sst_C), 8) == round(origin(depth_resampled), 8)), "\n")
cat("Extents match:    ", ext(sst_C) == ext(depth_resampled), "\n")
```

# Find suitable locations
## Create function
```{r}
suitable_locations_aquaculture <- function(species, sst_min, sst_max, depth_min, depth_max = 0){

# SST reclassification matrix
sst_rcl <- matrix(c(
  -Inf,   sst_min,  0,
  sst_min,  sst_max,  1,
  sst_max,  Inf,  0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

suitable_sst <- classify(sst_C, rcl = sst_rcl)

# Depth reclassification matrix
depth_rcl <- matrix(c(
  -Inf,   depth_min,  0,
  depth_min,  depth_max,  1,
  depth_max,  Inf,  0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

suitable_depth <- classify(depth_resampled, rcl = depth_rcl)

# Do not move on unless coordinate reference systems match 
if(st_crs(suitable_sst) != st_crs(suitable_depth)){
  stop("coordinate reference systems do NOT match,\ntry crs(suitable_depth) <- crs(suitable_sst)")
}


# Combine the temperature and depth rasters into one
suitable_combined <- c(suitable_sst, suitable_depth)
# Find cells that satisfy both SST and depth conditions
suitable <- lapp(suitable_combined, fun = function(temp, depth) temp * depth)


# Rasterize eez boundaries to match suitable's extent, resolution, and CRS 
eez_raster <- rasterize(eez, suitable, field = "rgn_id")

# Create a raster that has cell values from suitable within the eez_raster
suitable_eez <- mask(suitable, eez_raster)
# Remove zeros
suitable_eez[suitable_eez == 0] <- NA


# Calculate suitable area in each cell of the raster in km^2
cell_area <- cellSize(suitable_eez, unit = "km")

# Each cells in this raster contains their respective amount of suitable area in km^2 
suitable_area <- cell_area * suitable_eez

# Create a raster that has the same extent, resolution, and CRS as suitable_area
regions <- rasterize(eez, suitable_area, field = "rgn_id")

# Sum of suitable area per region 
suitable_eez <- zonal(suitable_area, regions, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)

# Transform into a data frame
suitable_area_eez <- suitable_eez|> 
  as.tibble() 


# Join the suitable area per region data frame with the eez vector data
area_eez <- left_join(suitable_area_eez, eez, by = "rgn_id")


# Display table of suitable area within each eez in order by area 
suitable_area_eez_table <- area_eez|> 
  select(rgn_id, rgn, area) |> 
  kable(col.names = c("Region Id", "Region", "Area (km^2)"), caption = paste0("Suitable Area per Exclusive Economic Zone, ", species)) |> 
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")



# Tranfrom the joined dataset into a simple feature for mapping
area_eez_sf <- st_as_sf(area_eez)


# Map the total suitable area within each eez
map <- tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +
tm_shape(area_eez_sf) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "area",
  fill.scale = tm_scale(
      values = c("lightsteelblue", "paleturquoise2", "paleturquoise3",
                 "cadetblue3", "seagreen4")),  # Reassign colors
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = " Area (km^2)", 
    position = tm_pos_out("right"), 
              frame = FALSE,
              title.size = 0.7)) +
tm_shape(suitable_area) +
  tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = "red"),
            col.legend = tm_legend_hide()) +
  tm_add_legend(type = "polygons", fill = "red", labels = "Suitable area") +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom")) +  # Add scale bar   
  tm_compass(position = c("right", "top")) + 
  tm_credits("Source: NOAA, GEBCO, Marineregions", position = c("left", "bottom")) +
  tm_title(paste0("Suitable Area for ", species, "\nby Exclusive Economic Zone")) +
  tm_layout(frame.lwd = 0.4)

print(map)
suitable_area_eez_table

}
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
suitable_locations_aquaculture("Oysters", 11, 30, -70, 0)
suitable_locations_aquaculture("Pink Abolone", 18, 25, -54, 0)
suitable_locations_aquaculture("Steelhead Trout", 7, 14, -6, 0)
```
